name: Yangzijiang Maritime Development Ltd.
summary: Yangzijiang Maritime Development Ltd. operates as a maritime financial solutions provider in Singapore. It operates through Cash Management; Maritime Fund and Maritime Investments Business; and Other Non-Maritime Investments segments. The company offers maritime investments, including direct vessel investments and divesting; maritime financing; and other non-maritime investments, such as fund-of fund investments and private credit investments. It also provides fund and cash management; maritime services; asset financing, including ship and pre-delivery financing, ship leasing, and secured loans; and value-added services, such as chartering, agency, broking, and advisory services.
